note: Stable codes. Lowercase snake_case to match the codes the engine and the hosted service already return (invalid_experts, experts_unavailable). Codes are never renamed or reused.

codes.skill_schema_invalid: The document does not match its schema (generic).
codes.skill_schema_type: A field has the wrong JSON type.
codes.skill_schema_unknown_field: A field the schema does not define (executable fields fail closed).
codes.skill_schema_value: A value is not one of the allowed values.
codes.skill_schema_format: A value does not match the required format (id, hash, reference, scope, time).
codes.skill_schema_limit: A size, count or numeric limit is exceeded.
codes.skill_schema_duplicate: A list that must hold distinct items repeats one.
codes.skill_schema_version_unsupported: schema_version names a major version this build does not read.
codes.skill_version_invalid: The version is not a valid semantic version, or does not increase.
codes.skill_hash_mismatch: The stated content hash differs from the one computed over the canonical executable fields.
codes.skill_not_found: No visible skill, version or run has that reference.
codes.skill_scripts_not_allowed: The definition carries scripts, install hooks, network access or a tool server; v1 rejects them.
codes.skill_too_large: The definition, folder or instructions exceed a byte ceiling.
codes.skill_composition_cycle: The composition graph has a cycle or a self-reference.
codes.skill_type_incompatible: An edge joins outputs and inputs that do not fit, or names an unknown node.
codes.skill_conflict: Duplicate node ids, two writers of one output, a hook that does not fit its target, or an ambiguous merge.
codes.skill_capability_unknown: A requested capability is not in the v1 vocabulary.
codes.skill_capability_denied: A capability was requested that the level, the policy or the grant does not allow.
codes.skill_audience_denied: The result would reach an audience the data is not cleared for.
codes.skill_quote_required: A paid or consequential step has no quote.
codes.skill_quote_expired: The quote or plan token has expired or no longer matches the request.
codes.skill_approval_required: The plan needs an approval that has not been given.
codes.skill_budget_exceeded: The worst-case cost exceeds the quote or the policy.
codes.skill_timeout: A step exceeded its time limit.
codes.skill_provider_error: The model provider failed or was unavailable.
codes.skill_tool_error: A brokered tool failed or was unavailable.
codes.skill_memory_error: The memory source was unavailable, stale or out of scope.
codes.skill_output_invalid: The skill output does not match its declared schema.
codes.skill_moderation_blocked: Moderation or a scan blocked the operation.
codes.skill_tenant_denied: The principal or team may not see or use this skill.
